title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules embeds into a finite sum of finite pushforwards of constant sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are an integer $n\ge0$ and, for $i=1,\dots,n$, a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] morphism $f_i:Y_i\to X$ which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and a finite $\Lambda$-module $M_i$, and a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules
$$F\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^n f_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$$
into the finite direct sum (biproduct [def-weil-additive-category]) in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$, where $\underline{M_i}$ is the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M_i$ on $Y_{i,\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and $f_{i,*}$ the direct image of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. (Stacks states this for Noetherian $\Lambda$; a finite morphism is quasi-compact and separated, so 'finite and locally of finite presentation' is 'finite and of finite presentation'.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), part (3), etale-cohomology.tex line 13028 (reference SGA 4, IX, Prop. 2.14)

proof.text:
*Noetherian approximation of $F$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-noetherian-descent] applied to the quasi-compact quasi-separated $X$ and the constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F$ there are a Noetherian scheme $X'$, a morphism $
u:X	o X'$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F'$ on $X'_{\Et}$ and an isomorphism $\alpha:
u^{-1}F'\xrightarrow{\sim}F$. (In Stacks: write $X=\lim_tX_t$ with $X_t$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$ and affine transition maps, Limits 01ZA; by Lemma 09YU (3) the category of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X$ is the colimit of those on the $X_t$, so $F$ is the pullback of a constructible $F_t$ on some $X_t$; take $X'=X_t$, $
u$ the projection, $F'=F_t$.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7, proof, first paragraph ('We will reduce this lemma to the Noetherian case ... is the pullback of a similar constructible sheaf F_t over X_t for some t'), etale-cohomology.tex lines 13059-13066

proof.text: *The Noetherian case.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-pushforward-noetherian], realized by `AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.exists_mono_biproduct_lowerStar_of_isNoetherian_etaleModule`, directly to the descended sheaf and its `Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf` proof. This retains constructibility of every stratum and produces finite morphisms, finite module values, and the required monomorphism on the Noetherian base. No conversion to the disputed `IsConstructibleSheaf` predicate is used.

source.place: Lemma 09Z7, proof: 'Then we apply the Noetherian case (Lemma 09Z6) to find an injection F_t -> (+) f_{i,*} M_i over X_t for some finite morphisms f_i : Y_i -> X_t', etale-cohomology.tex lines 13066-13075

proof.text: *The $f_i$ are of finite presentation.* $X'$ is Noetherian, in particular locally Noetherian, and each $f_i$ is finite; a finite morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme is of finite presentation [pqf-lem-finite-fp-locnoeth] (Mathlib: `AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite.instLocallyOfFiniteType` together with the instance `LocallyOfFinitePresentation f` for `[IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]`, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Noetherian.lean:265). Hence each $f_i$ is finite and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation].

source.place: Lemma 09Z7, proof: 'Since X_t is Noetherian the morphisms f_i are of finite presentation', etale-cohomology.tex line 13076

proof.text:
*Pulling the embedding back to $X$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-embedding-pullback] applied to $
u:X	o X'$, $F'$, the finite and locally finitely presented $f_i$ of Step 3, the $M_i$ and the monomorphism $\varphi$ of Step 2, there are finite morphisms $g_i:Y'_i	o X$ locally of finite presentation (the base changes $Y_i	imes_{X'}X	o X$) and a monomorphism $\varphi':
u^{-1}F'\hookrightarrow igoplus_{i=1}^ng_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$ in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ with the same finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$. (In Stacks: pullback is exact, so $
u^{-1}\varphi$ is injective; $
u^{-1}$ commutes with finite direct sums; and $
u^{-1}f_{i,*}\underline{M_i}=g_{i,*}(
u')^{-1}\underline{M_i}=g_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$ by Lemma 0959 and the fact that the inverse image of a constant sheaf is constant.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7, proof, last sentence: 'Since pullback is exact and since formation of f_{i,*} commutes with base change (Lemma 0959), we conclude', etale-cohomology.tex lines 13077-13080

proof.text: *Conclusion.* The composite $\varphi'\circ\alpha^{-1}:F\to\bigoplus_{i=1}^ng_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$ of the isomorphism $\alpha^{-1}$ of Step 1 and the monomorphism $\varphi'$ of Step 4 is a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, with $g_i$ finite and locally of finite presentation and $M_i$ finite $\Lambda$-modules, as asserted. (A finite morphism is quasi-compact and separated, so each $g_i$ is also of finite presentation, which is the form of Stacks 09Z7.)

split_report.summary: Split along the proof of Stacks 09Z7, which is also the structure of WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/FinitePushforward.lean: (1) descent of F to a Noetherian scheme (new node lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-noetherian-descent, Stacks 01ZA + 09YU(3); Lean exists_isNoetherian_upperStar_iso, not attached, see below), (2) the Noetherian case 09Z6(3) (new node lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-pushforward-noetherian = Lean exists_mono_biproduct_lowerStar_of_isNoetherian, sorry_here), (3) finite over Noetherian is of finite presentation (existing pqf-lem-finite-fp-locnoeth, a Mathlib fact: Noetherian.lean:265), (4) pullback of the embedding (new node lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-embedding-pullback = Lean exists_mono_biproduct_lowerStar_upperStar, sorry-free, for attachment), (5) composition with the isomorphism (elementary). The existing nodes lem-weil-pbc-constructible-finite-pushforward-noetherian / -approximation are the abelian-group torsion forms (09Z6(2), 09Z7(2)) and do not give Lambda-linear maps, so Lambda-module nodes were created. Lambda: Stacks needs Lambda Noetherian (09YU(3), 09YV, 09Z4 go through finitely presented Lambda-modules); the node's finite Lambda is Noetherian. LEAN DISCREPANCY: the attached Lean exists_mono_biproduct_lowerStar uses the source repository's IsConstructibleSheaf, whose strata are arbitrary locally closed subsets (Topology.Stratification has no constructibility), weaker than def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf (constructible strata). With it the Lean statement is false: X=Spec(prod_N F_2), x a non-principal ultrafilter point (closed, not open, so {x} is closed but not constructible), F=i_*Z/2 for i:{x}->X; F is Lean-constructible (strata {x}, X\{x}), but a monomorphism F -> (+) g_{i,*}M_i with g_i finite of finite presentation is impossible: the global section 1 of F has support {x}, the support of a global section of g_*M is the image of a clopen subset of Y under the finite finitely presented g, which is closed and constructible (Chevalley), and a monomorphism preserves supports. The same example (j_!Z/2 for the non-quasi-compact open j: X\{x} -> X, or i_*Z/2) refutes exists_isNoetherian_upperStar_iso and exists_isNoetherian_mono_biproduct_lowerStar (an inverse image of a constructible sheaf from a Noetherian scheme has constructible support). The node itself is right (its definition has constructible strata); the Lean statement must not be attached as stating it unless IsConstructibleSheaf requires constructible strata.
